name: West Valley College Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Students in grades 9 to 12 take West Valley College classes for free. Middle College and on-campus dual enrollment exist for some districts.
who_can_apply: Concurrent enrollment: grades 9 to 12. Middle College: juniors and seniors from LGSUHSD and CUHSD. Dual enrollment on high school campuses: CUHSD (Campbell Union High School District) students only.
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Follow the college's term dates.
how_to_apply: Start at the college's high school students page and apply through the admissions portal; the page also covers assessment, orientation and registration.
notes: Ask the college about unit limits and your counselor about credit.
